resources.string: Chooses whether White Noise follows your device\'s light or dark setting, or always uses Light, Dark or AMOLED (pure black). The choice applies on this device only and takes effect immediately.
Sets the accent color of buttons and highlights for the current theme. It applies to the active profile on this device, and backgrounds and surfaces stay neutral. You can reset it to the default.
Sets the default colors of your message bubbles and of other people\'s bubbles for the current theme. It applies to the active profile on this device. Each chat can still have its own colors.

Opens a list of typefaces for all text in White Noise. The choice applies on this device only and takes effect immediately. System uses your device\'s own font, and the other typefaces are built into the app.

Opens the text size choices for White Noise. The size is added on top of your Android system font size, so both settings affect how large text looks. It applies on this device only and takes effect immediately.
Opens the choices for how times and dates are written, such as 12-hour or 24-hour time and the order of day, month and year. The choice applies on this device only and takes effect immediately.
Shrinks White Noise text to 85 percent of the normal size. The change is added on top of your Android system font size and applies on this device only.
Uses the normal White Noise text size, so text is as large as your Android system font size makes it. This is the starting setting, and it applies on this device only.
Enlarges White Noise text to 115 percent of the normal size. The change is added on top of your Android system font size and applies on this device only.
Enlarges White Noise text to 130 percent of the normal size. The change is added on top of your Android system font size and applies on this device only.
Puts the White Noise text size back to Default, which follows your Android system font size without adding to it. The dialog stays open, and the change applies on this device only.
Uses your Android device\'s own font for all text in White Noise. This is the starting setting, and the choice applies on this device only.
Uses this typeface, which is built into the app, for all text in White Noise. The choice applies on this device only. Your Android system font size still applies as well.
Writes times in the style your app language and region use, as a 12-hour or 24-hour clock. This is the starting setting, and it applies on this device only.
Always writes times on a 12-hour clock with AM and PM, whatever your language or region uses. The choice applies on this device only.
Always writes times on a 24-hour clock, whatever your language or region uses. The choice applies on this device only.
Writes dates in the order your app language and region use. This is the starting setting, and it applies on this device only.
Always writes short dates in the order shown by this example, whatever your language or region uses. The choice applies on this device only.
Sets both time and date back to Automatic, which follow the app language and your region. This button is available only while you have changed one of them, and it applies on this device only.
Shows or hides a sample chat where you can try right-to-left layout and larger text. Nothing you do in the preview changes your real settings.
Shows the sample chat with a right-to-left layout, as used for languages such as Arabic and Hebrew. It changes only the preview and not the rest of the app.
Doubles the text size in the sample chat to show how larger text fits. It changes only the preview and not your font size settings.
Turns off both preview switches and returns the sample chat to your real settings. Your actual app settings are not changed.
Switches the language of White Noise on this device. The change applies immediately. System follows the language set in your Android settings.
Keeps incoming messages silent while a podcast or audiobook plays, so it is not interrupted. Mentions still alert you. The setting applies on this device.
Chooses what happens when you swipe a message to the left with your finger. The setting applies to every chat on this device. You can turn it off or pick another action.
Chooses what happens when you swipe a message to the right with your finger. The setting applies to every chat on this device. You can turn it off or pick another action.
Chooses what happens when you swipe a chat in the chat list to the left with your finger. It is off by default. The setting applies on this device only.
Chooses what happens when you swipe a chat in the chat list to the right with your finger. It is off by default. The setting applies on this device only.
Puts all swipe actions and the pull-down for unread chats back to their starting settings. Nothing in your chats changes, and the reset applies on this device only.
Chooses which speech engine on your device reads messages aloud. Engines marked as on-device keep speech on your phone, while others may use the network. The choice applies on this device only.
Chooses the voice used to read messages aloud. Automatic lets the speech engine choose the voice. Voices that are unavailable are shown with the reason. The choice applies on this device only.
Sets how fast messages are read aloud. System follows the speech rate in your Android settings, or you can pick a preset or enter your own. The choice applies on this device only.
Turns on reading unread messages aloud when you open a chat. Each chat can override this default and choose On or Off for itself. The setting applies on this device only.
When on, read-aloud speech plays over music or other media that is already playing. When off, speech reads normally. The setting applies on this device only.
Sets how loud read-aloud speech is when it plays over other media: Quiet, Medium or Loud. It is available only while speaking over media is on, and applies on this device only.
Checks again which speech engines and voices are installed on your device. Use it after installing or removing a speech engine. It changes none of your settings.
Opens your Android device\'s own text-to-speech settings, where you can install voices and manage speech engines. When you come back, White Noise rechecks what is available.
Chooses whether this chat reads unread messages aloud when you open it. You can follow your default or force it On or Off for this chat. The choice applies on this device only.
Follows your global Read Aloud default for this chat, which is shown in parentheses. If you change the default later, this chat changes with it.
Always reads unread messages aloud when you open this chat, whatever your default says. The choice applies on this device only.
Never reads messages aloud automatically when you open this chat, whatever your default says. The choice applies on this device only.
Chooses which speech recognition service turns your voice into text in the message box. Automatic picks one for you. The choice applies on this device only.
Pauses music and podcasts while you dictate and resumes them afterwards. White Noise speech and voice messages always pause. The setting applies on this device only.
Chooses when dictation ends: when you choose Paste or Send, or automatically after a set number of seconds of silence. The setting applies on this device only.

Chooses what happens to the text when dictation ends by silence: it is pasted into your draft, or sent as a message. Sending happens only if the chat and draft are unchanged. The setting applies on this device only.
Opens your Android device\'s own voice input settings, where you can manage speech recognition services and keyboard voice typing.
Opens the Offline Speech to Text listing on Zapstore, an app store. It is recommended for private dictation done on your device, and it is not available on Google Play.
Lets White Noise choose a speech recognition service for you each time you dictate. The choice applies on this device only.
Uses this speech recognition engine for dictation in the message box. The label below it shows how it can be used. The choice applies on this device only.
Applies this preset color. You can still fine-tune it with the sliders or the hex code, and nothing is saved until you press Save.
Sets the base color, such as red, green or blue. Drag the slider below to change it. Nothing is saved until you press Save.
Sets how vivid the color is, from gray to full color. Drag the slider below to change it. Nothing is saved until you press Save.
Sets how light or dark the color is. Drag the slider below to change it. Nothing is saved until you press Save.
Saves this action color for the active profile and the current theme on this device. It is available once the color is valid and different from the saved one.
Removes your custom action color for the current theme and goes back to the default. It applies to the active profile on this device.
Saves the chosen bubble colors. They apply to the active profile on this device, or only to this chat when you opened this screen from a chat.
Opens a menu with a reset action that clears your custom bubble colors here and goes back to the defaults.
